subject: WA builds more prison beds as Closing the Gap goes backwards
posts:
Western Australia builds more prison beds as Indigenous incarceration rates soar past targets.
Evidence: rising remand rates, housing shortages, Closing the Gap failure
#Aletheia #Australia #Justice

Official policies aim to reduce Indigenous incarceration and close systemic gaps by 2031.
Stated Judgement: (+1.00, +1.00) — Good Preference

WA incarceration rates have worsened dramatically while prison capacity expands without transitional housing.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.93, -0.85) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Systemic failures are met with carceral expansion rather than structural support.

Integrity: Meaningful Distortion (Hypocrisy: 8.5, z: 2)

- WA Justice Infrastructure: FAIL (-0.93, -0.85) — Pours capital into cells while starving community diversion.
- Closing the Gap Targets: COND (0.10, -0.60) — Paper commitments broken by carceral budget allocations.

Western Australia has the highest Aboriginal adult imprisonment rate nationally, missing Closing the Gap targets while expanding custodial infrastructure instead of addressing housing and remand drivers.

The Poison:
Funding flows into prison beds rather than community-led housing and diversion programs.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT (carceral expansion) with WHO (systemic empowerment), treating poverty and homelessness as criminal risks rather than social failures.

Social Physics Analysis:
The state runs a Smart Selfish Maneuver by substituting systemic housing solutions with prison bed expansion, projecting criminality onto poverty while dodging structural reform.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Systemic neglect compounds carceral dependency.

The Unavoidable Truth: Expanding prison beds without housing guarantees higher recidivism.

The Unavoidable Lie: Carceral growth represents progress toward closing the gap.

Alethekanon:
Treating symptoms with cages while ignoring root causes accelerates institutional failure.

Awwthekanon:
Every person trapped in the remand cycle deserves a safe home, dignity, and a real chance to rebuild their life on Country.

Brothekanon:
Building more cells when people just need a roof over their head is completely backwards.

Spirithekanon:
"Is not this the fast that I choose: to loose the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke?" Isaiah 58:6 FAIL
Building new cages while sacred treaties of equality go backwards deepens ancestral injustice instead of healing it.
